_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Pratt & Whitney (moteurs, signal hypercroissance MRO post-PMM), Collins Aerospace (avionique, marges robustes), Raytheon Defense (defense USA+international), Backlog (visibilite), CA total.
_note_segments: FY21/22 Raytheon = somme Raytheon Intelligence & Space + Raytheon Missiles & Defense (restructure en 1 segment Raytheon en FY23). Comparabilite indicative.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance MRO post-resolution Powder Metal Matter (GTF), +17%/an FY25, programme A320neo/F-35
kpis.description_fr: Moteurs aero commerciaux (GTF/PW1100G) + militaires (F135/F-35). Creux FY23 lie au Powder Metal Matter (PMM) GTF, rebond fort FY24-25.
kpis.description_en: Commercial (GTF/PW1100G) + military (F135/F-35) aero engines. FY23 dip from Powder Metal Matter (PMM) GTF, strong FY24-25 rebound.

kpis.signal: Avionique + interieurs + systemes electriques, croissance reguliere post-Covid, marge op ~16%
kpis.description_fr: Avionique, interieurs cabine, systemes electriques/mecaniques. Croissance reguliere apres reprise aero commercial post-Covid.
kpis.description_en: Avionics, cabin interiors, electrical/mechanical systems. Steady growth post-Covid commercial aero recovery.

kpis.signal: Defense missiles, radars, espace. FY21/22 incluent RIS+RMD (perimetre legacy avant restructure FY23)
kpis.description_fr: Defense : missiles (Patriot, NASAMS, Stinger), radars, espace. FY21/22 = somme legacy Raytheon Intelligence & Space + Raytheon Missiles & Defense.
kpis.description_en: Defense: missiles (Patriot, NASAMS, Stinger), radars, space. FY21/22 = legacy sum Raytheon Intelligence & Space + Raytheon Missiles & Defense.

kpis.signal: Bond historique +50 Mds en 1 an, visibilite revenue ~3x CA annuel, contexte geopolitique tendu
kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes total (RPO). 268 Mds$ fin FY25 (~3x CA annuel). Bond +50 Mds vs FY24, beneficiaire des tensions geopolitiques.
kpis.description_en: Total backlog (RPO). $268B end FY25 (~3x annual revenue). +$50B jump vs FY24, beneficiary of geopolitical tensions.

kpis.signal: Acceleration FY24-25, beneficiaire double tailwind aero commercial + defense
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide RTX. Acceleration FY24-25 portee par double tailwind : aero commercial (Collins, P&W) + defense (Raytheon).
kpis.description_en: RTX consolidated revenue. FY24-25 acceleration driven by dual tailwind: commercial aero (Collins, P&W) + defense (Raytheon).
